purpose: Visual validation of shared material correction, not pixel-accurate certification

references.observed: Dark brown fur with warm directional shading. No large gray-white shoulder/forearm wash as in the old export. Pose broadly matches our idle; stage differs.
Original Melee website screenshot: warm highlights on skin, dark fur on Jungle Japes.
Original Melee website screenshot: fur stays brown on Temple, with white action streaks distinguished from material highlights.

Armor deliberately has bright local highlights, particularly shoulder and thigh. Do not disable specular globally. Our source-color correction retains colored highlights; placement/intensity still depends on the approximate light rig.
Blue tunic remains saturated; metal trim and sword retain lighter highlights. Our corrected material should not flatten these to matte.

limitations: Different stage lighting, camera angle, GIF palette and capture resolution prevent a numerical pixel match.
Original textures, geometry, animation, material flags, highlight color and shininess are retained. Cycles/Principled remains an adaptation of GX rendering.
controls: Before/after use identical model, textures, pose, lights, camera and Cycles settings. The material mapping alone changes.

verification.notes: Legacy Dr. Mario and Roy anchors cause subpixel differences. Roy’s existing sword/afterimage edge contacts are retained; no new clipping was accepted. All installed entries use source-specular-v1.
